propositions.name: ether_fills_all_space
propositions.statement: There exists a medium called the ether whose vibrations produce the phenomena of heat and light and which is supposed to fill all space.
propositions.quote: The undulatory theory of light assumes the existence of a medium called the ether, whose vibrations produce the phenomena of heat and light, and which is supposed to fill all space.

propositions.name: fresnel_partial_ether_drag
propositions.statement: The ether enclosed in optical media partakes of the motion of these media to an extent depending on their indices of refraction.
propositions.quote: According to Fresnel, the ether, which is enclosed in optical media, partakes of the motion of these media, to an extent depending on their indices of refraction.

propositions.name: air_ether_drag_negligible
propositions.statement: For air the motion of the ether would be but a small fraction of that of the air itself and will be neglected.
propositions.quote: For air, this motion would be but a small fraction of that of the air itself and will be neglected.

propositions.name: ether_at_rest_earth_moves
propositions.statement: The ether is at rest and the earth moves through it.
propositions.quote: Assuming then that the ether is at rest, the earth moving through it, the time required for light to pass from one point to another on the earth's surface, would depend on the direction in which it travels.

propositions.name: absolute_rest_state_meaningful
propositions.statement: It is meaningful to speak of the time required to perform the journey if the earth were at rest, so that a state of absolute rest is a definite fact.
propositions.quote: time required to perform the journey if the earth were at rest.

propositions.name: one_way_time_direction_dependent
propositions.statement: The time required for light to pass from one point to another on the earth's surface depends on the direction in which it travels.
propositions.quote: the time required for light to pass from one point to another on the earth's surface, would depend on the direction in which it travels.

propositions.name: velocity_of_light_single_valued
propositions.statement: There is a single velocity of light V in the ether that is a known quantity independent of the observer.
propositions.quote: we have thus far no method for measuring the velocity of light which does not involve the necessity of returning the light over its path, whereby it would lose nearly as much as was gained in going.

propositions.name: classical_velocity_composition
propositions.statement: The velocity of light in the earth's frame is V minus v or V plus v, so the difference depends on the square of the ratio of the two velocities.
propositions.quote: The difference depending on the square of the ratio of the two velocities, according to Maxwell, is far too small to measure.

propositions.name: wavelength_yellow_stable_standard
propositions.statement: A wave-length of yellow light can serve as a stable standard by which the quantity, if it exists, is easily measurable.
propositions.quote: The following is intended to show that, with a wave-length of yellow light as a standard, the quantity — if it exists — is easily measurable.

propositions.name: transverse_light_unaffected_by_motion
propositions.statement: If the light travels in a direction at right angles to the earth's motion it would be entirely unaffected in its time of going and returning.
propositions.quote: If, however, the light had traveled in a direction at right angles to the earth's motion it would be entirely unaffected and the time of going and returning would be, therefore,

propositions.name: path_difference_shifts_fringes
propositions.statement: The actual distance the light travels in one direction is greater than in the other by a definite quantity that produces a displacement of the interference bands.
propositions.quote: That is, the actual distance the light travels in the first case is greater than in the second, by the quantity

propositions.name: arms_equal_paths_after_compensation
propositions.statement: With bc made equal to bd and a plate of glass g compensating for the thickness of glass b, the two rays traverse equal paths and are in condition to interfere.
propositions.quote: the two rays will have traveled over equal paths and are in condition to interfere.

propositions.name: rotation_preserves_apparatus_geometry
propositions.statement: Rotating the support by 90 degrees preserves the geometry of the apparatus and its axis remains vertical.
propositions.quote: At the end of each series the support was turned 90°, and the axis was carefully adjusted to the vertical by means of the foot-screws and a spirit level.

propositions.name: temperature_effects_direction_independent
propositions.statement: The changes of temperature of the arms are independent of the direction of the arms, so that their effect could be eliminated.
propositions.quote: On the other hand, since the changes of temperature are independent of the direction of the arms, if these changes were not too great their effect could be eliminated.

propositions.name: brass_arm_expansion_shifts_fringes
propositions.statement: A temperature difference of one one-hundredth of a degree between the brass arms would displace the fringes three times as much as the rotation effect would.
propositions.quote: if one arm should have a temperature only one one-hundredth of a degree higher than the other, the fringes would thereby experience a displacement three times as great as that which would result from the rotation.

propositions.name: earth_orbital_speed_ratio_known
propositions.statement: The velocity of the earth in its orbit gives a known ratio v to V used to predict the expected displacement.
propositions.quote: Considering only the velocity of the earth in its orbit, the ratio

propositions.name: solar_system_moves_toward_hercules
propositions.statement: The estimated direction of the motion of the solar system is toward the constellation Hercules, at an inclination of about 26 degrees to the plane of the equator.
propositions.quote: At this time of the year, early in April, the earth's motion in its orbit coincides roughly in longitude with the estimated direction of the motion of the solar system — namely, toward the constellation Hercules.

propositions.name: components_have_geometric_resultant
propositions.statement: Two component motions have a resultant coinciding more nearly with the plane of the equator the closer the two components are in magnitude.
propositions.quote: The nearer the two components are in magnitude to each other, the more nearly would their resultant coincide with the plane of the equator.

propositions.name: arms_perpendicular_align_with_motion
propositions.statement: If the arms point north and east at noon then the east arm coincides with the resultant motion and the other is at right angles to it.
propositions.quote: In this case, if the apparatus be so placed that the arms point north and east at noon, the arm pointing east would coincide with the resultant motion, and the other would be at right angles.

propositions.name: observations_repeatable_when_undisturbed
propositions.statement: When some slight cause suddenly changes the position of the fringes the series is rejected, so that undisturbed series give reproducible positions.
propositions.quote: It frequently occurred that from some slight cause (among others the springing of the tin lantern by heating) the fringes would suddenly change their position, in which case the series of observations was rejected and a new series begun.

propositions.name: no_displacement_of_interference_bands
propositions.statement: The observations show that there is no displacement of the interference bands.
propositions.quote: The interpretation of these results is that there is no displacement of the interference bands.

propositions.name: stationary_ether_hypothesis_erroneous
propositions.statement: Because there is no displacement of the interference bands, the hypothesis of a stationary ether is shown to be incorrect and erroneous.
propositions.quote: The result of the hypothesis of a stationary ether is thus shown to be incorrect, and the necessary conclusion follows that the hypothesis is erroneous.

propositions.name: aberration_theory_presupposes_stationary_ether
propositions.statement: The generally accepted explanation of aberration presupposes that the earth moves through the ether, the latter remaining at rest.
propositions.quote: This conclusion directly contradicts the explanation of the phenomenon of aberration which has been hitherto generally accepted, and which presupposes that the earth moves through the ether, the latter remaining at rest.

propositions.name: round_trip_required_for_light_speed
propositions.statement: There is no method for measuring the velocity of light which does not involve returning the light over its path.
propositions.quote: we have thus far no method for measuring the velocity of light which does not involve the necessity of returning the light over its path, whereby it would lose nearly as much as was gained in going.

propositions.name: instrument_sensitive_to_vibration
propositions.statement: The apparatus is so sensitive to vibrations that ordinary stone piers and daytime work do not suffice for measuring the fringes.
propositions.quote: If this was the case with the instrument constructed with a view to avoid sensitiveness, what may we not expect from one made as sensitive as possible!
